sentences.en: The company distributed fact sheets to all employees.
sentences.zh: 公司给所有员工发放了情况简报。

sentences.en: Before the meeting, she prepared a detailed fact sheet.
sentences.zh: 会议前，她准备了一份详细的资料摘要。

sentences.en: The sales team uses fact sheets to brief new clients.
sentences.zh: 销售团队用情况简报来向新客户介绍情况。
